stops.note: tufan, "a big cyclonic storm": the word used in the Quran for Noah's flood; the same word was also used in Persian and Hindi/Urdu as a shared loan
influenced by Chinese 'tai fung', great wind, and by Greek Typhon, the monster of storms
stops.meaning: a violent storm of the Indian Ocean

stops.note: entered English for storms of the India and China seas, later reshaped in spelling under the influence of Cantonese tai fung ('great wind') and the Greek storm-giant Typhon

current_meaning: a severe tropical cyclone occurring in the western Pacific or Indian Ocean
